channel.comment: IMPORTANT: this pipeline uploads with the SAME YT_TOKEN_JSON as the Shorts pipeline, i.e. onto the SAME YouTube channel (@SweetSoulStories007). Descriptions used to welcome viewers to 'MoralTales', a brand that does not exist on that channel. The name is aligned here so the audience, the branding and YouTube's topic model all agree. If these long-form stories are ever moved to their own channel, change this back and give that channel its own token.
